scope: Continues the merged RSC-O route (PR #60 two-anchor planarity, PR #63 alternation transfer, PR #64 one-sided silent layer at 6f4d32e1). Two new proposals. PROP-P3-FORCED-ADDRESS-ACCOUNTING-01 (forced-address accounting completeness): in any exact closure question every registered address that receives nonzero individual forcing must be represented and resolved as ACTIVE (amplitude != 0), EXACT-CANCELLED (net forcing 0, individual contributions != 0, ledgered), NULL-BY-REGISTERED-GEOMETRY (ORTH / EQSHELL nullity) or TED; a forced address absent from state and ledger is UNRESOLVED and the closure test is INVALID. It is NOT the statement that every forced address must be populated; the exact-cancellation branch is kept. Encoded per forced address as the disjunction (amplitude != 0) or (net forcing = 0), run as System A (amplitude saturated nonzero) and System B (amplitude = 0 and net forcing = 0), each reported; the forgotten case (amplitude = 0 and net forcing != 0) is run so the loophole is seen. Symbolic pair sums are saturated by t.t != 0 because the denominator-cleared projection vanishes on complex isotropic sums. RSC-O branch B reduced on this skeleton only; branch C, RSC-O global, RSC-E / RSC-C, OCSR, Witness Soundness, G6/G7 and Clay Navier-Stokes regularity remain OPEN.
